sam.precision: CUDA autocast bfloat16, returned/interpolated logits float32

weights.jz: native pixel area; GSD undocumented, explicitly reported; same-dataset constant scale only

neural.shuffle: torch CPU Generator seed0, new randperm each epoch
neural.head: SAM original 256->256->256->4, ReLU between layers, original configured output activation; keep weights; candidates use output channels1..3
neural.hybrid: Linear(256+F,256),ReLU,Dropout(.1),Linear(256,1); two Linear layers; random torch seed0 initialization
neural.manual_preprocessing: replace nonfinite with train-only per-column median (all missing=>0); train-only mean/std (std0=>1); token raw; fit separately within every training split
neural.target: cached full queried-object IoU; robust targets retained at cached8decimal precision

nested.grouped: inner leave-one-region/event out within outer training; aggregate TP and union over all inner-held units and BOTH P1/P2 before selecting weight
nested.external: reuse full17-region validation for v1.1; no v1.1 training
nested.tiles: train fit, val compare joint P1P2; final fit train+val
nested.ties: strict numerical maximum; exactly tied follow unweighted,sqrt,area order
nested.fit_memoization: same dataset/method/weight/sorted training units => identical seed0 fit; reuse irrespective of outer fold; never use held targets in fit
nested.refit: fresh seed0 initialization on full outer training

baselines.R0: argmax SAM original scores over all available12 or3 candidates
baselines.fixed_pool: multiscale16 rules: scale ascending,R0/R1/R2/R3; single4 rules
baselines.training_best: joint P1/P2 wholeIoU best among fixed rules using complete final outer training data; tiesfirst; same reference for all three models
baselines.posthoc: choose separately per reported metric on evaluated test view, hold rule fixed during bootstrap; actual unavailable
baselines.upper: GT per-query argmax, not deployable or global union optimum
baselines.box: reuse existing; jz/bijie missing boxes generated once on full tile, tight user-simulated GT bbox, multimask=False; robust FP32 input path

bootstrap.victory: unit or event wholeIoU delta with tolerance1e-12

interaction.confidence: raw selected predicted IoU; no calibration/clipping
interaction.random: 20 nested permutations default_rng(seeds0..19), shared across models/P1P2 withinview
interaction.target: 0.9*full box wholeIoU; minimum tested k; random20mean; no interpolation

scope.GVLM_v1_1_main: six excluding Saint; all7 appendix; predictions same, allocation recomputed eachview
scope.CAS: same existing1500 sampled tiles, all resolutions grouped together
scope.jz_bijie: eligible prompted tiles as robust; supplement missing val with same>=100 component and common split rules; no negative-only tiles in unit mean

single_scale_logscale.jz: log2(max(tile_height,tile_width)); native pixel scale due to unknown GSD
